evidence: In the 2D and 3D-top views the C1/R3/C2 cluster immediately left of U1 is stacked with no visible gap between bodies and crowds U1's left pin row, leaving no assembly clearance.
Pin headers J2 and J3 sit in the board interior far from any edge, so wire access must cross the board surface; only the RJ45 J1 reaches the top edge with its opening facing outward.
The C1/R3/C2 cluster is a ragged overlapping stack rather than an aligned row, and the R1/R2/C3 parts below U1 are bunched with uneven spacing instead of a clean grid.
In the 2D view the C1, R3 and C2 designators overlap each other and U1's pads, and R1/R2/C3 run together as one illegible string over their parts.
The entire bottom half and lower-left of the board are empty dead space while all components are congested in the upper-center band around U1.
